May 2021 - May 2023
Assistant Manager
Wipro
Collaborated with product managers to gather and document
reporting requirements.
Migrated legacy Excel reports to Tableau BI, enhancing data
accessibility and visualization.
Cleansed and transformed large datasets to ensure accuracy and consistency in reportings transactional product reports like, Equity, Bonds, Derivatives etc.
Supported change management activities, including
development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.
Designed and maintained interactive Tableau dashboards for
various business units.
Created Gantt charts to visualize project timelines and
milestones, aiding in project tracking.
Actively participated in Agile ceremonies including Sprint
Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives, ensuring clear understanding of requirements and alignment with development teams.
Collaborated with Product Owners and Scrum teams to define, refine, and prioritize user stories in JIRA, ensuring timely and quality delivery of sprint commitments. Designed UAT test scenarios and supported business
stakeholders during User Acceptance Testing to validate system functionality against business requirements. Assisted in defect tracking, triage, and resolution by
coordinating between business users, QA, and development teams to ensure smooth release delivery.
Led cross-functional teams to streamline operational
processes, significantly improving efficiency and enhancing project delivery timelines.
Managed project lifecycles using Agile methodologies,
ensuring timely delivery of technology solutions aligned with client objectives.
